M1.reason: Silhouette overlap is below 0.80 in every view: front/back 0.642, left/right 0.49, top/below 0.383. In the front and back views the arms are stiff straight tubes held away from the body, with flat caps that stick up above the shoulders, where the original's arms hang relaxed with bent elbows. The coat skirt is a boxy flap that sticks out at the hips. In the side views the stride and the arms differ from the original's walking pose. From above and below, the arm-tube caps and the box-shaped coat give a different outline. It reads as a human figure but is clearly off.

M2.reason: Measured 32.3 x 22.8 x 69.3 against 32.3 x 21.7 x 68 for the original (off by 3%, 4.9% and 1.9%). All three are within 10%.

M3.reason: The lab coat, trousers, shirt, tie, glasses, belt buckle, hands and brown shoes are all there. The grey hair fringe around the back and sides of the head is missing; the back views show the original's grey band and a bare scalp on the reproduction. The coat is not an open coat with lapels and a fitted body. It is panels plus a separate rectangular skirt flap. The sleeves are capped cylinders and the hands are tiny. Parts are present but several have the wrong shape.

M4.reason: Mean colour difference (CIE76 delta E) is 18.4, above the line of 15, and every view except right is over 15 (left is 22.7). The original's shirt is a dark navy blue; the reproduction's is a pale light blue. The tie is red with dark stripes on navy in the original and brighter red on light blue in the reproduction. The coat and trousers are a flatter, greyer white, and the grey hair is gone.

M5.reason: The tie stripes, glasses and belt are there. The coat's folds and soft shading are missing, as are the shirt's pocket and texture detail, the face's wrinkles and the grey hair. The surfaces are flat and plain next to the original's shaded cloth.

M6.reason: It reads as a bald scientist in a white coat with glasses and a red tie, but a player would not take it for the original. The stiff tube arms with their caps, the box-flap coat skirt, the pale shirt and the missing hair are visible at the size the game shows it.

M7.reason: It faces the original's front, stands upright, and its feet rest on the ground plane at the same height as the original's.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors. It has 1360 triangles, under twice the original's 740 (limit 1480). The views show nothing open, inside out or floating; the sleeve ends are capped.

C1.reason: Through the run the parts stay roughly on the body, but the motion is off. The coat skirt flap swings out as a separate slab at the hip (run2 frames 6/22, 9/22, 19/22, 22/22) and looks like it comes away from the body. The arms swing as rigid tubes with the upper arm thrown far back, unlike the original's compact bent-elbow pumping. The stride is longer and lower than the original's. Only a run was shown, with no attack or walk to judge.
